data.explanation: Your landlord has settled the yearly operating costs (heating, water, waste, insurance, etc.) for your apartment and found that you paid €66.00 more than your actual share, which they say they will transfer back to your known bank account within the next few days. There is no deadline or action required from you right now, but you may want to check the figures and that you receive the refund. If anything looks incorrect, you can contact your landlord using the phone number on the letter; German tenants generally have time to raise objections to such statements, so keep this document for your records.
